diff_summary: Unread count requests now share one in-flight Promise.
Successful visible polling self-schedules one second after completion.
Hidden state cancels the timer; visibility restoration, focus and drawer open refresh immediately.
Silent consecutive failures back off to two, five and fifteen seconds.
Closed drawer updates only the bell; open drawer refreshes list and module summaries only when unread count changes.
